title: Positions That Move
description: Every time a shipment's position advances, the record of WHEN it last moved should advance right along with it.
successCondition: Book a shipment and note its position_updated_at via `npm run db:psql`. Call POST /api/tracking/:id/advance as dispatcher/admin twice (a few seconds apart), and re-query the row after each call. position_updated_at strictly increases after each advance call, and is always more recent than the value recorded before that call.
hints: positionUpdatedAt is set to the current time on every successful /advance call, not just the first one (apps/api/src/modules/tracking/service.ts) — check it after both calls, not just the first.
select position_updated_at from shipments where id = '<id>'; between calls, with a short pause so the timestamps are visibly distinguishable.
